entities.name: Query protein 602 aa
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q58714 (MJ1318) from Methanocaldococcus jannaschii; identity and coverage are both 100%.
Predicted/reference architecture includes transmembrane helices at residues 11–31, 103–123, and 577–597.
Contains a Lon_C Pfam domain at residues 48–171; reference annotation also identifies a Lon proteolytic domain at residues 25–210.
Sequence-derived properties: 602 aa, approximately 67.3 kDa, theoretical pI 5.17, and charge at pH 7 of approximately -14.1.

entities.name: Q58714 MJ1318
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference from Methanocaldococcus jannaschii; annotated as a cell-membrane, multi-pass membrane protein.
Annotated molecular functions include ATP binding, ATP-dependent peptidase activity, peptidase activity, and serine-type endopeptidase activity.
Annotated biological processes include proteolysis and protein catabolic process.

entities.name: Protein quality control
observations: The reference annotations for MJ1318 support a role in ATP-dependent proteolysis and protein catabolism, consistent with cellular protein quality control.
